claims.claim: On Friday CBC reported an hourslong Microsoft outage affecting Microsoft 365 offerings that interact with Exchange Online, with users reporting Outlook, Teams and Copilot down.
claims.episode_span: Users reported Outlook, Teams and the Copilot assistant down.
claims.source_title: Microsoft outages extend into 2nd day, company not aware of malicious activity
claims.supporting_quote: Services including Outlook, Teams and AI assistant Copilot were reported by users to be down.

claims.claim: Microsoft said malicious activity was not to blame for the Outlook outage and reported making headway in fixing it.
claims.episode_span: The company said malicious activity was not to blame
claims.source_title: Microsoft faces a major Outlook outage: ‘no signs of a cyberattack’
claims.supporting_quote: Microsoft said "malicious" activity was not to blame for an Outlook outage that left users around the world without its crucial services on Friday, November 13, but reported making headway in fixing the massive disruption.

claims.claim: The outage began Thursday, continued Friday, and Microsoft blamed server problems.
claims.episode_span: the break began on Thursday and was still hitting people around the world on Friday
claims.source_title: 'One of the biggest outages ever': Disruption to Microsoft services enters second day
claims.supporting_quote: An outage of Microsoft services such as Outlook, Teams and Copilot that began on Thursday continued to cause disruption to users around the world on Friday as the tech giant struggled to fix server problems it blamed for the problems.

claims.claim: The IEA said Friday that fourth-quarter oil supply will exceed demand for the first time since the Iran war began in February, and Gulf exports are at 74 percent of pre-war levels.
claims.episode_span: the first time supply has exceeded demand since the war in Iran began in February
claims.source_title: Oil supply to exceed global demand for first time since Iran war
claims.supporting_quote: It will be the first time since the start of the war in Iran in February that supply has exceeded demand, the International Energy Agency (IEA) said on Friday.

claims.claim: Brent crude is trading at 96 dollars a barrel, down from more than 117 dollars at the end of October.
claims.episode_span: Brent crude is trading at 96 dollars a barrel, down from more than 117 dollars
claims.source_title: Oil supply to exceed global demand for first time since Iran war
claims.supporting_quote: Brent crude is now trading at 96 dollars a barrel, down from more than 117 dollars at the end of October.

claims.claim: The IEA raised its 2026 supply estimate by 920,000 barrels a day and now sees a 2026 average deficit of 685,000 barrels a day versus 1.7 million previously, with a quarterly overhang of roughly 2 million barrels a day.
claims.episode_span: raised its estimate of global oil supplies in 2026 by 920,000 barrels a day
claims.source_title: IEA Sees Oil Surplus for First Time in Iran War
claims.supporting_quote: The agency bolstered estimates for global oil supplies in 2026 by a substantial 920,000 barrels a day.

claims.claim: Saudi production reached 10 million barrels a day in October and Iraq’s output reached 4.6 million a day, a seven-year high.
claims.episode_span: Saudi production reached 10 million barrels a day in October.
claims.source_title: IEA Sees Oil Surplus for First Time in Iran War
claims.supporting_quote: Saudi Arabia raised crude production to 10 million barrels a day in October, while Iraq’s output reached a seven-year high of 4.6 million a day, according to the report.

claims.claim: IEA members will discharge a further 71 million barrels of emergency stocks through the end of February, and global demand is forecast to fall by 2.68 million barrels a day this year to 102.3 million.
claims.episode_span: discharging a further 71 million barrels through the end of February
claims.source_title: IEA Sees Oil Surplus for First Time in Iran War
claims.supporting_quote: IEA members will speed up the release of remaining emergency oil stockpiles pledged earlier this year, discharging a further 71 million barrels through the end of February, according to the report.

claims.claim: President Trump said he told Vice President JD Vance that the United States does not need a deal with Iran and asked him to focus on corruption and crime in Democratic-run cities and states.
claims.episode_span: President Donald Trump said he had told Vice President JD Vance
claims.source_title: Why is Trump saying ‘no deal necessary’ with Iran as he sidelines JD Vance?
claims.supporting_quote: US President Donald Trump said he had told his country’s lead negotiator, Vice President JD Vance, that, “We don’t need a deal with Iran.”

claims.claim: Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps said it destroyed a US early-warning radar in Bahrain in retaliation for an attack on a telecommunications centre in Iran.
claims.episode_span: Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps said it destroyed a US early-warning radar in Bahrain
claims.source_title: Iran threatens unlimited response over Strait of Hormuz after US attack
claims.supporting_quote: Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps says it destroyed a US early-warning radar in Bahrain in retaliation for an attack on a telecommunications centre in Iran.

claims.claim: Tehran said the Bahrain radar strike answered an air attack on a telecommunications tower in Sirik.
claims.episode_span: Tehran said the radar strike answered an air attack on a telecommunications tower in the southern port city of Sirik.
claims.source_title: Why is Trump saying ‘no deal necessary’ with Iran as he sidelines JD Vance?
claims.supporting_quote: On Friday morning, Tehran said it had attacked and destroyed an early-warning radar system belonging to the US military in Bahrain, in what it said was retaliation for an air attack on a telecommunications tower in southern Iran’s port city of Sirik.

claims.claim: Secretary of State Marco Rubio said economic pressure on Iran is proving effective and that large-scale military operations need not resume.
claims.episode_span: Secretary of State Marco Rubio said Washington’s economic pressure campaign against Iran is proving effective
claims.source_title: Why is Trump saying ‘no deal necessary’ with Iran as he sidelines JD Vance?
claims.supporting_quote: Secretary of State Marco Rubio has said that Washington’s economic pressure campaign against Iran is proving effective, so a resumption of large-scale military operations is unnecessary.

claims.claim: The Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo has a new epicenter largely isolated from aid by an armed group that has killed and kidnapped aid workers.
claims.episode_span: the Ebola outbreak has a new epicenter largely isolated from aid
claims.source_title: Why Aid Isn’t Reaching Ebola’s Epicenter
claims.supporting_quote: The Ebola outbreak in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has a new epicenter, one largely isolated from aid by an armed group that has killed and kidnapped aid workers.

claims.claim: Judge Ana C. Reyes voiced strong opposition to coordination with Iran but did not grant an injunction to halt information sharing.
claims.episode_span: Judge Ana C. Reyes voiced strong opposition
claims.source_title: The U.S. and Iran are at war. But ICE is still working with Tehran on deportations
claims.supporting_quote: In a court hearing transcript, Judge Ana C. Reyes voiced strong opposition to the Trump administration’s coordination with the Iranian government. Reyes did not grant an injunction to halt information sharing, however, and will decide whether to allow the case to proceed in the coming months.

claims.claim: Yasmine Chubin said attorneys knew of at least a dozen Iranian detainees approached about removal in recent weeks, and one attempted suicide.
claims.episode_span: attorneys knew of at least a dozen detainees approached about removal in recent weeks
claims.source_title: The U.S. and Iran are at war. But ICE is still working with Tehran on deportations
claims.supporting_quote: Yasmine Chubin, executive director of the Iranian advocacy group, said the organization’s attorneys knew of at least a dozen detainees approached about removal in recent weeks.

claims.claim: Ukraine and Russia agreed to expand the next round of negotiations to include European countries, and Kushner and Witkoff held over four hours of talks with Putin before briefing Zelensky in Dublin.
claims.episode_span: Ukraine and Russia agreed to widen the next talks to European countries
claims.source_title: US, Ukraine say Europe to join peace talks as Putin sticks to hardline stance
claims.supporting_quote: In a packed day of shuttle diplomacy following negotiations in Abu Dhabi, Kushner and fellow envoy Steve Witkoff held over four hours of talks with Putin in the Kremlin before jetting to debrief Zelensky in Dublin.

claims.claim: New York officials ended rescue efforts after eight people died and 18 were injured in a Brooklyn collapse, including four firefighters injured and two children among the dead.
claims.episode_span: officials ended the Flatbush search on Thursday after eight people died and eighteen were injured
claims.source_title: Rescue Ends in Brooklyn After 8 Die in Building Collapse
claims.supporting_quote: Eighteen other people, including four firefighters, were injured in the collapse and its aftermath at 1321 Flatbush Avenue. Two children who were cousins were among the eight killed, according to an internal police report.

claims.claim: Heavy rain in Gaza flooded and damaged thousands of tents and several people died.
claims.episode_span: heavy rain flooded and damaged thousands of tents and several people died
claims.source_title: Humanitarian situation in Gaza worsens amid political deadlock
claims.supporting_quote: In war-battered Gaza, heavy rain flooded and damaged thousands of tents. Several people died.

claims.claim: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia chief executive on Thursday; Colette Kress is interim chief, and the share price fell 4.3 percent by Thursday’s close.
claims.episode_span: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia’s chief executive on Thursday
claims.source_title: Fallout from Nvidia scandal spreads as Huang resigns
claims.supporting_quote: Jensen Huang resigned as chief executive of Nvidia on Thursday after revelations of extramarital affairs, including one with a woman accused of spying for China. The news wiped 4.3% of Nvidia’s share price by closing bell Thursday

claims.claim: Port Mellon recorded 307 millimetres of rain from Tuesday morning to Thursday noon, the highest in the province, and Kennedy Lake recorded 261 millimetres.
claims.episode_span: Port Mellon with 307 millimetres of rain from Tuesday morning to Thursday noon
claims.source_title: Flooding worsens along B.C.’s South Coast as heavy rains continue
claims.supporting_quote: The weather agency reported rainfall levels of 307 millimetres in Port Mellon from Tuesday morning to Thursday at noon, the highest in the province, followed by Kennedy Lake on Vancouver Island, with 261 mm.

claims.claim: Angela Rayner approved full planning permission for a site near Piddington for more than 1,200 detained asylum seekers, and the Home Office said a final decision to proceed has not yet been taken.
claims.episode_span: Angela Rayner approved full planning permission
claims.source_title: Planned asylum centre near Oxfordshire village to face legal challenge
claims.supporting_quote: It emerged on Thursday that Angela Rayner, the housing and communities secretary, had approved full planning permission , a decision welcomed by the Home Office, who want to end the use of asylum hotels.
